title: AC1024 census VIEWPORT typed output/readback profiles

source.fixturePolicy: Reused the existing local DWG witness; no DWG or DXF fixture was added.

formatAuthority.finding: The DWG body lists viewport geometry/view/render fields and handle references; DXF groups 68 and 69 are not fields in this DWG entity body. Their output values are adapter projections derived from paper-space ordering.

implementation.change: Added focused physical-source output/readback for the two AC1024 census VIEWPORTs.

outputReadback.route: Import the physical DWG, export the full source in explicit AllowPartial mode, then freshly import each exact DXF output.
outputReadback.identityJoin: DXF output handles are allocated anew. Each of the two source handles must match exactly one output by its unique admitted typed field projection and the same ENTITIES adapter container; output handles must be valid and non-aliased.
checked: space, container, layer/linetype, color, transparency, lineweight, linetype scale, material/plot-style/shadow and visibility fields
viewport geometry, center, view target/direction, clipping, snap/grid, view length/height, status flags, stylesheet, render mode, UCS fields, shade mode, default lighting and effective ambient color
extension dictionary owner role, complete entry count/order/names, and each XRECORD target existence, owner and field count
DXF-only group 68/69 projections are exactly the two values 1/1 and 2/2; they are not compared as source DWG body fields

failureAndRetry.negativeControl: Set the first source VIEWPORT viewHeight to positive infinity; the writer refuses and preserves a pre-existing destination sentinel.
failureAndRetry.retry: Restore the original value and retry with the same adapter; both encodings export and freshly reimport.

focusedSelector.result: PASS for ASCII and Binary; both census profiles, selected fields, container membership, extension dictionary/XRECORD owner links, derived group 68/69 projection, atomic refusal and same-adapter retry verified.

validation.fullSuites: NOT RUN; touched warning-as-error target build and focused physical selector were sufficient for this profile slice.

limitations: Export uses AllowPartial; strict complete-export remains closed by 228 opaque callback views and zero retained correlation frames.
The output comparison proves the listed selected typed profile and owner edges; it is not independent CAD, native-platform or rendered viewport qualification.
No support claim or external item is promoted.
